description: This PHP source file defines the `SugarRestJSON` class, which implements a JSON-based REST interface for the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for generating JSON responses, serving REST requests, and handling faults, indicating it is part of the API layer handling JSON requests and responses.

classes.name: SugarRestJSON
classes.description: A class that provides JSON implementation of REST protocol, handling request serving, response generation, and error handling for the CRM REST API.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON encoded response, with optional JSONP callback support, or a fault response if `faultObject` is set.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Processes incoming REST requests by invoking the specified method on the implementation object, decoding JSON input, and returning the result or error.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets the fault object to be returned in case of an error.

methods.name: generateFaultResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON encoded error/fault object, with optional JSONP callback support.
